firmware.title: MPEG Video Player
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; pl_mpeg
firmware.description: An MPEG-1 video player on pl_mpeg: 320x240 video with stereo sound, streamed from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard. Arrows: choose, Enter: play, Space: pause, Esc: back to the list.
